body:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in external action failures and memory OOMs on runtime-pool-7. Error rate for 'action.invoke' up 18x over baseline. Auto-mitigation attempted: short-circuiting heavy batch queue.
Tess (oncall): saw this, paging oncall. I'm on it. Which tenants hit first?
Samir Patel: metrics -> increased action.invoke latency, concurrent KV-cache pressure. A few long-running agent sessions are pinning GPUs.
Alex Chen: confirming logs show repeated external tool chains (webhook and file-parser) causing memory growth per session.
Julie Moreno: support reports ~6 customers reporting malformed JSON outputs in threads around the same time. Might be related.
Tess (oncall): immediate mitigation proposal: pause external/third-party action invocations + disable structured JSON output for lower-tier plans as a quick traffic-shape. Keep enterprise customers on by-default if they have SLA. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Evan (eng-runtime): technically doable. We can flip a runtime flag to reject action calls at the routing layer, and an API gate to force "plain-text" responses instead of structured output. Will need a rapid rollback plan.
Samir Patel: prefer gradual: 1) throttle action.invoke per-tenant to 1 rps, 2) global block for new action sessions from free/trial, 3) force-plaintext for all non-enterprise.
Tess (oncall): agree with gradual. We want minimal customer impact but must stop OOM loop. Can we do step 1 in the next 90s?
Evan (eng-runtime): yes. Pushing a config change now: `ri-config apply --set runtime.action_rate_limit=1 --scope=tenant_quota --ttl=30m`
IncidentBot: DEPLOYMENT: config-change started by Evan (eng-runtime). CI: #deploy-4812.
Alex Chen: also adding a runtime-side hardcap on per-session memory growth: `RUNTIME_MAX_SESSION_MEM=6G` as a guard. Applying with canary to pool-7 only.
Samir Patel: monitoring... latency dropping on pool-7 but actions still fail with 503 from downstream tool adapter.
Support Ops: gathering affected customers list now — will surface tenant IDs and contact emails in next 5m.
Maya (customer-ops): priority: free and trial users likely impacted. Enterprise customers A and C reported increased errors but much smaller footprint.
Tess (oncall): ok timeline: 00:00 root alert, 00:02 throttle applied, 00:05 plain-text fallback ready. Next steps: notify support + run targeted mitigation for heavy sessions.
Julie Moreno: drafting outbound note for impacted customers: short explain + workaround (disable agent plugins or reduce session length). Will share for review.
Evan (eng-runtime): rolling plain-text fallback: `feature-toggle set structured_output=false --scope=plans:free,trial --duration=60m` now.
Samir Patel: seeing a 60% reduction in memory growth where fallback is active. Still seeing 1-2 noisy tenants. Listing in thread: tenant_7432, tenant_8121.
Tess (oncall): isolating those tenants to read-only for actions: `admin quarantine tenant_7432 tenant_8121 --block-actions --reason="OOM-surge"`
IncidentBot: ACTION: tenants tenant_7432, tenant_8121 quarantined by Tess (oncall). Notifying account owners.
Support Ops: sent targeted emails to affected tenant owners + in-app banners for free/trial: "We are temporarily restricting third-party action calls to protect service stability." Link to status page: https://status.redwood-inference.example/incident/1727777777
Alex Chen: request for eng-runtime: if this persists after 30m escalate to full action-disable for all non-enterprise and open emergency capacity to move heavy sessions to dedicated nodes.
Evan (eng-runtime): noted. I'll open the capacity request and pre-warm dedicated GPUs if needed.
Samir Patel: keeping a watch on error budget and token costs. If error budget drops under 85% we should do broader restriction.
Tess (oncall): handing off to Samir for next 45m. I'm stepping off on-call for a quick break, will be reachable. Samir, take lead and ping me if we need exec notification. :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: taking over. I'll coordinate with Support Ops for customer comms and with Evan for further mitigations.
Evan (eng-runtime): FYI deploy bot reports minor rollback on canary due to unrelated flake, but mitigation flags persist. Watching memory metrics.
Support Ops: updated the incident doc with affected tenants + transcripts: https://confluence.internal/incident/1727777777
Julie Moreno: sent customer email template for review. Asking legal if any required SLA credits.
Maya (customer-ops): prepping priority outreach for enterprise A & C.
Samir Patel: current status at 00:28: action.invoke error rate down 10x, memory growth stabilized on 6/8 pools. Remaining action failures concentrated on quarantined tenants. Plan: keep throttle + plaintext fallback for 60m, then test gradual re-enable for trial with tighter per-session mem caps.
Tess (oncall): thanks team. Please escalate to incidents if we need exec comms. Will draft a short postmortem once stabilized.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place. Next checkpoint in 30m. Reviewer: Samir Patel.
Alex Chen: small note for post-ops: consider auto-adaptive backoff for action-heavy sessions and a circuit-breaker that gracefully returns plain-text + suggested plugin disable hints to users.
Samir Patel: noted, adding to follow-up action items.
Support Ops: closing customer notifications loop for initial cohort. No P1 support cases opened so far.
Evan (eng-runtime): last check at 00:48: all pools stable, memory within limits. Leaving flags in place until 01:20.
Tess (oncall): incident handover complete. Samir -> please mark incident as "monitored" and schedule a 1hr follow-up to validate re-enable path.
Samir Patel: will do. Thanks all. :pray:
